items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So I met Bill, and Bill asked me to play a few tunes... he hired me on the spot... we went into a place called the Top Hat Lounge, and went in there for two weeks... he kept us for a year.

ctx.x: And so I played in the high school, you know these little concerts and things. And then one day I was sitting on my front porch playing the ukulele and a guy came by in a car and stopped in the front of the house, and says — and I wondered why is this guy out here? And he just stood there and I kept playing. So finally he called me to come over to his car. I came over and got in the car with him and he says, “how long you been playing?” So I guess I’d been playing about two years. So he said, “well I got somebody…
Lounge, and went in there for two weeks. And the man liked it so well he kept us for a year. One straight year. Seven days a week.
